Toward Structural Fatigue Analysis of Horizontally-Fabricated NiTi via Selective Laser Melting

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Transferable Skim only mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Parisa Bayati, Ahmadreza Jahadakbar, Keyvan Safaie, Mohammadreza Nematollahi, Hediyeh Dabbaghi et al. Volume 1: Additive Manufacturing; Advanced Materials Manufacturing; Biomanufacturing; Life Cycle Engineering; Manufacturing Equipment and Automation 2020-09-03 10.1115/msec2020-8473
单位: University of Toledo, Toledo, OH
通讯: Parisa Bayati @ University of Toledo, Toledo, OH
相关性: 该论文研究了SLM制备NiTi的疲劳行为，与用户关注的LPBF制备生物医用植入物的疲劳性能相关，但未涉及多孔结构或应力遮挡。
边界: This paper does not link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, nor does it report surface roughness, as-built morphology, or osseointegration.
动机· 研究SLM制备NiTi的疲劳行为，以支持其工程应用。
方法· 对水平方向SLM制备的NiTi狗骨试样进行应变控制疲劳测试和断口分析。
结果· 揭示了SLM制备NiTi的疲劳失效机制及缺陷影响。
验证· 通过疲劳实验和断口形貌分析验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the fatigue behavior of SLM-fabricated NiTi, which differs from conventionally processed material, for reliable application under cyclic loading.
Method· Strain-controlled fatigue tests were conducted on horizontally-fabricated NiTi dog-bone samples, followed by fractographic analysis to identify failure causes.
Result· The study identified key defects and failure mechanisms influencing the fatigue life of SLM NiTi.
Validation· Experimental fatigue testing and fractography were used to validate the findings.

Method· A literature review covering metal AM technologies, materials, mechanical and chemical surface finishing methods, and surface characterization parameters.

Validation· No experimental validation; this is a review paper.

Surrogate Pore Generations in L-PBF Ti64 and Effects on Mechanical Behavior

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Transferable Skim only mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Shanshan Zhang, Sabina Chertmanova, Kevin Chou Volume 1: Additive Manufacturing; Advanced Materials Manufacturing; Biomanufacturing; Life Cycle Engineering; Manufacturing Equipment and Automation 2020-09-03 10.1115/msec2020-8470
单位: University of Louisville, Louisville, KY
通讯: Shanshan Zhang @ University of Louisville, Louisville, KY
相关性: 该论文研究了LPBF Ti64中人为孔隙的生成及其对力学性能的影响，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能，与用户研究方向间接相关。
边界: This paper does not link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, does not cover fatigue testing, and lacks surface roughness or osseointegration analysis.
动机· 验证LPBF Ti64中人为孔隙生成的可行性并表征其影响
方法· 在拉伸试样中设计并生成关键孔孔隙，通过X射线CT表征，并进行拉伸测试
结果· 孔隙主要影响延展性，对弹性模量、屈服强度和抗拉强度影响不显著
验证· 通过X射线CT和拉伸测试验证孔隙特征与力学性能
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To demonstrate the feasibility of generating surrogate pores at specific locations in L-PBF Ti64 and characterize their effects on mechanical behavior.
Method· Surrogate keyhole pores were induced by single track exposures with varying energy density and scan parameters during L-PBF, and characterized by X-ray CT and tensile testing.
Result· Pore formation increased with energy density and number of tracks/layers, but only ductility was noticeably affected, not Young's modulus, yield strength, or tensile strength.
Validation· Validation was performed via X-ray computed tomography for pore characterization and tensile testing with fractography for mechanical properties.

Accelerating engineering design by automatic selection of simulation cases through Pool-Based Active Learning

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling arxiv Transferable Save for project simulation_case
J. H. Gaspar Elsas, N. A. G. Casaprima, I. F. M. Menezes arXiv preprint 2020-09-03 link
相关性: 该论文提出的主动学习方法可减少仿真次数，对用户研究中的昂贵有限元仿真加速具有参考价值。
边界: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on single-objective simulation case selection for offshore riser design.
动机· 减少工程设计中大量冗余仿真带来的计算开销。
方法· 采用池式主动学习选择最具信息量的仿真案例。
结果· 仅用20%的仿真案例即可近似完整设计组合的结果。
验证· 在海洋立管设计案例中验证了80%仿真缩减的准确性。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To reduce the computational burden of evaluating numerous simulation cases in engineering design by exploiting redundancy.
Method· A pool-based active learning technique selects the most informative simulation cases to approximate the full design space.
Result· The method achieves an 80% reduction in required simulations while maintaining a reasonable approximation of the complete system.
Validation· Validation is performed on an offshore riser design simulation portfolio, demonstrating accuracy with a subset 80% smaller than the original.

Novel Multitask Conditional Neural-Network Surrogate Models for Expensive Optimization

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark
Jianping Luo, Liang Chen, Xia Li, Qingfu Zhang IEEE Transactions on Cybernetics 2020-09-03 10.1109/tcyb.2020.3014126
单位: Guangdong Key Laboratory of Intelligent Information Processing, Shenzhen University, Shenzhen, China
通讯: Jianping Luo @ Guangdong Key Laboratory of Intelligent Information Processing, Shenzhen University, Shenzhen, China
相关性: 该论文提出了一种多任务条件神经过程代理模型，可提高昂贵优化问题的采样效率，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的多目标优化与约束处理。
边界: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification in the context of surrogate modeling.
动机· 多任务学习可共享信息，避免从头学习，提高优化效率。
方法· 提出两种基于条件神经过程的多任务代理模型，并嵌入贝叶斯优化框架。
结果· 在多个基准问题上，所提方法优于高斯过程和单任务方法。
验证· 通过数值基准测试验证模型性能。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Multitask learning can share information across related tasks to avoid tabula rasa learning and improve optimization efficiency.
Method· Two multitask conditional neural process surrogate models are proposed and integrated into a Bayesian optimization framework to replace Gaussian processes.
Result· The proposed methods outperform Gaussian process-based, single-task, and other multitask Bayesian optimization methods on several benchmark problems.
Validation· Validation is performed on numerical benchmark functions.

Method· A physics-informed data-driven framework constructs multi-level surrogate models from multi-scale multi-physics simulation data, calibrated with experiments.
Result· The framework demonstrates surrogate modeling for high-dimensional temperature fields and parameter calibration for reliable UQ.

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project simulation_case UQ Patient-specific
Huijuan Xu, Davide Baroli, Alessandro Veneziani Journal of Biomechanical Engineering 2020-09-03 10.1115/1.4048336
单位: School of Mechanical Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology, Atlanta, GA 30332; Siemens Coporate Technology, Princeton, NJ 08540
通讯: Huijuan Xu @ School of Mechanical Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology, Atlanta, GA 30332; Siemens Coporate Technology, Princ
相关性: 该论文展示了全局敏感性分析在患者特异性主动脉模拟中的应用，其方法（PCE、Sobol指数）可迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的不确定性量化。
边界: This paper focuses on hemodynamics and aortic flow, not on implant mechanics, stress shielding, or FEA surrogate modeling for orthopedic implants.
动机· 量化主动脉模拟中几何、边界条件和LES参数对临床指标的影响。
方法· 基于多项式混沌展开和Sobol指数进行全局敏感性分析。
结果· 临床指标对几何参数最敏感，且敏感性在心动周期不同时刻和区域有差异。
验证· 使用患者纵向影像构建几何随机过程，并通过LES模拟验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To quantify the sensitivity of clinically relevant hemodynamic indices to patient-specific geometry, inflow conditions, and LES modeling parameters in aortic simulations.
Method· A global sensitivity analysis using polynomial chaos expansion (PCE) and Sobol' indices, treating geometry and inflow as stochastic processes.
Result· The quantities of interest (TKE, TAWSS, OSI) are most sensitive to geometry, with sensitivity varying over the cardiac cycle and spatial regions.
Validation· Validation via simulation case using longitudinal patient images to construct a physically consistent geometric stochastic process.

边界: This paper does not incorporate AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage, nor does it advance toward autonomous decision-making.
动机· 探究绿色生物打印中针头直径对藻类细胞生长的影响。
方法· 使用不同针头直径（22、25、27号）打印含藻类细胞的生物墨水，测量细胞计数。

Motivation· To investigate the effect of needle diameter on the post-printing growth of Chlamydomonas reinhardtii algae cells in green bioprinted constructs.
Method· Bioprinted constructs with bioink containing algae cells using three needle diameters (22G, 25G, 27G) and quantified cell counts on days 2 and 5.
Result· Decreasing needle diameter correlated with lower cell counts and reduced magnitude of cell count increase between days 2 and 5.
Validation· In vitro cell count measurements validated the correlation between needle diameter and cell growth.

Result· Molten pool and remolten region dimensions depend anisotropically on process parameters, and large scanning spacing leads to pore defects between adjacent tracks.
Validation· Numerical predictions are compared with experimental trends from literature for validation.

边界: This paper does not address FEA, surrogate modeling, optimization, uncertainty quantification, or any biomechanical or implant design context.
动机· 改进大班教学中幻灯片设计以提升学生参与度和学习效果。
方法· 采用句子标题幻灯片并整合课前课后版本及课堂小测验。
结果· 课堂提问次数增加，出勤率从69%提升至83%，小测验平均分95%。
验证· 通过问卷调查和考试成绩统计分析验证效果。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To address the limitations of sentence-headline slides in large classes by integrating active learning measures to improve engagement and attendance.
Method· Implemented pre- and post-lecture slide versions with blanks and end-of-class quizzes to promote note-taking and attendance.
Result· Instructor questions increased from fewer than 5 to over 20 per class, attendance rose from 69% to 83%, and quiz scores averaged 95%.
Validation· Validated via student surveys, attendance records, and chi-square analysis of exam scores.
